body:
# C-08B: fixed displaced T1 increment, seeds5..8

2 October 2026. Second authorised batch complete and stopped:16 fresh candidates,32 planner invocations,12 new complete certificates and four retained unknown candidates. Cumulative offline bank has25 accepted material entries plus the separately certified fallback. `complete:false` remains correct.

## Changed files and preservation

Claims preceded edits in `codex-C-08B.md`. Changed owned driver `scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs`, tests `scripts/dev/test-displaced-t1-bank.mjs`, derived `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/displaced-v1/bank-manifest.json`, parent report and this report. New immutable directories: `docs/expeditions/v2/certification/four-locks/displaced-v1/bank-candidates/tier-1-{river,islands,hedges,terraces}-seed-{5,6,7,8}/`.

Driver accepts explicit `--batch 1-4` or `--batch 5-8`, with exact seed membership and16-candidate scope. Unsupported ranges/options fail before work. Newly written generation/result metadata records batch identity; mismatched candidate/checkpoint/result identities reject. Original evidence without the optional batch field stays valid. Completed evidence from the other authorised batch is independently replayed into cumulative coverage. Existing unknown slots are never retried. GeneratorVersion2 packet identity, two8000-state limits, real production replay, printed-stat/card assignments, output diversity, winning physical alcove proof and canonical/fallback gates are unchanged.

All140 original evidence files, including the four seed0 packets and entire seeds1..4 batch, have matching before/after SHA256 `5268163984a0e58df3271f47444187508038ab64867e26d48bb17101ff57936e`. Digest covers sorted relative filenames and exact file bytes. Existing dirty changes were preserved. Claude-owned source, runtime version1 reference, App/save integration and shared build outputs were not edited.

## Executable checks and evidence

```text
node scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs --batch 5-8
node --test --test-reporter=spec scripts/dev/test-displaced-t1-bank.mjs expeditions/v2/generation/displaced-four-locks.test.js expeditions/v2/generation/runtime-generation.test.js scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs
node scripts/dev/assemble-displaced-t1-bank.mjs --batch 5-8
```

All29 targeted checks pass. New tests validate explicit seed/batch identities, unsupported ranges, retained result/checkpoint identity, all16 new independent certifications, reconstruction of12 accepted packets, exact cumulative manifest membership/coverage and unchanged fail-closed gates. Earlier production preview/reducer, card strength, alcove endpoint, interruption/no-retry, tampering and runtime tests still pass.

First batch invocation processed16/skipped0, exactly two requests per candidate at8000 states.26 new winning traces contain701 accepted commands. Each `traces.json` in the new immutable directories is the executable production-reducer evidence; each `result.json` records both requests, actual reported counters and independent certificate. Second invocation processed0/skipped16 with zero new generator/planner calls and no evidence rewrites. No screenshots: this is offline reducer certification, not live UI acceptance.

Four unknown candidates lack two distinct target teams and different output plans. Islands seed6 retains its real alcove win but lacks the direct win. River seed7 retains a direct win but lacks an alcove win; river seed6 and terraces seed5 have neither. Unknown is bounded absence of proof, not impossibility. They are retained without additional attempts.

Claude-owned R-07 warning remains: six exhausted requests report denied-spend overages6,13,8,4,17,19, total67. Requested caps remain8000. Reported counters do not establish actual admitted reducer work beyond the cap. No planner repair, threshold/cost/enemy weakening or cap escalation.

No automatic next batch; fixed seeds5..8 increment is stopped. C-08B remains in progress; advisory lock released after result handoff to scrum and Claude.
